audience_question: Which retrofit barrier is most common overall, and did service turnaround improve?
form: Separate-source evidence panels with an answerability checklist
fit_rationale: A single slide can show the two sources side by side while keeping their populations and incomplete measures distinct; an explicit answerability panel names the shared data needed before ranking barriers or comparing turnaround.
tradeoff: The slide gives up a ranked or trend visual because the sources lack compatible denominators, overlap rules, and a comparable baseline.
caveats: North survey respondents could select multiple barriers, so its counts overlap.
South reviewed 15 open cases, but total homeowners served was not reported and other barriers were not recorded.
South turnaround median is 8 days for 11 cases; four cases have no time recorded.
The “around two weeks last spring” note has no identified cases, sample size, or method and is not a comparable baseline.
Partners have no shared period definition or common denominator.
